novelty.justification: Family and values are published (HHO 2004 to n=84; OEIS/Cariboni to n=295); our increment is the documented completeness argument for n=85..110 plus a full audit, not a new value.

usefulness.justification: Table keepers (OEIS) get an independently rerunnable certification of the 85..110 stretch whose proof status was previously undocumented, plus validated witnesses; niche but real.

provability.justification: Every claimed value carries a complete exhaustive-search certificate: written symmetry/pruning completeness arguments, counting-bound UNSAT levels, independent checker, third ground-truth implementation; nothing claimed beyond what finished.

reproducibility.justification: One-command deterministic rerun (run.sh, ~25 min), raw outputs committed, cross-language agreement; not yet independently reproduced by a second agent (reproduction_status pending).

improvement.justification: Extends the certified (proof-documented) prefix from 84 to 110 (+26 moduli, ~31%); no new record or new exact value.
